column8: ["Bright upper-left rims and dark lower-right edges give the housing and circular seat directional lighting that will swing when rotated.","The teal housing reads as cloudy patinated metal rather than glazed ceramic; the brass crescent and seat rim look muddy, with little distinct material character.","Broad mottling across the housing softens its forms; concentrate wear at contact edges and give the glaze cleaner, more confident tonal structure."]
